# Nabdah Plus - نبض بلس
# Comprehensive Healthcare Platform - Saudi Arabia

## About
Nabdah Plus (نبض بلس) is a comprehensive healthcare super-app serving patients in Saudi Arabia. The platform connects patients with doctors, pharmacies, laboratories, nursing services, and more — all from a single mobile application.

## Services

### Doctor Consultations
- Video, audio, and text consultations with licensed physicians
- 35+ medical specialties available
- Clinic visits, home visits, and online consultations
- Second opinion service
- Follow-up consultations

### Pharmacy
- Prescription upload and OCR scanning
- Medication delivery to your door
- Barcode scanning for quick ordering
- Drug interaction checker
- Broadcast ordering to nearby pharmacies

### Laboratory & Diagnostics
- Home sample collection
- 100+ lab tests available
- Result tracking and history
- Lab comparison
- Package deals for comprehensive checkups

### Home Nursing
- 15+ nursing services available
- Injection administration
- Wound care
- IV therapy and cannula insertion
- Elderly care
- Post-operative care
- Mother and newborn care
- Vital signs monitoring

### Health Records
- Digital health ID with QR code
- Vital signs tracking (blood pressure, heart rate, glucose, temperature, oxygen)
- Medication reminders
- Family health management
- Medical reports and prescriptions storage
- Chronic disease management
- Sleep tracking

### Insurance
- 20+ Saudi insurance companies supported
- Coverage verification
- Claim submission and tracking
- Benefits summary

### AI Health Tools
- AI symptom checker
- Skin analysis
- Prescription translator
- Drug interaction scanner
- Monthly health reports

### Mental Health
- Licensed psychiatrists and psychologists
- Breathing exercises
- Meditation sessions
- Mood journaling

### Nutrition
- AI meal plan builder
- Calorie analyzer
- Food scanner
- Body composition tracking
- Exercise plans

### Emergency Services
- SOS button with automatic GPS sharing
- Direct ambulance booking
- Emergency contact management

## Coverage
- Available throughout Saudi Arabia
- Major cities: Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah, Madinah, Dammam, Al Khobar, Khamis Mushait, Tabuk, Abha, Taif

## Languages
- Arabic (العربية)
- English
- Urdu (اردو)
- Hindi (हिन्दी)
- Bengali (বাংলা)
- Filipino

- Website: https://nabdahplus.com
